classification: MULTI_FACTOR, dominated by BOUNDED_ARCHITECTURAL_LIMITATION (the buildComposite discard-on-poison materialization defect, affecting 6 of 10 real holdout claims per 01) with a narrow, explicitly out-of-scope IR_EXPRESSIVITY_GAP residual (A4's categorical-filter case, 1 of 10 claims, per 02) and 2 claims (A3/Maintenance-EBITDA, A6/Invoice-Restrictions) whose gap is SOURCE_CONTEXT, not a semantic-computation-architecture defect at all and therefore not Unit A's to fix.

definitionVsRuleDistinction.principle: A definition may be computationally executable, or at least substantively captured, even if it emits zero CovenantRules - '0 rules' is never used alone as evidence of failure in this remediation's scoring.
definitionVsRuleDistinction.application: B1 (Applicable Liquidity Threshold) is direct evidence of this: its calculationExpression compiled cleanly to a real IF tree with sufficiency=COMPLETE, yet it produced 0 rules - the gap there is downstream rule-emission/threshold-wiring, not calculationExpression capture. This mission's semantic pass gate (per its own Section 17/18 language, echoed in 12) is scored on DEFINITION-level substantive capture (material clauses/caps/branches represented, expression semantics structurally present, verifier finds no MATERIAL omission) - not on rule count. The remediation plan below targets calculationExpression/definition-level capture, matching that gate definition; it does not require every remediated definition to also emit a CovenantRule.

primaryFix_buildCompositePreservation.summary: Per 03's expression-type-analysis: give IRUnsupportedExpression an additive, optional `attemptedStructure?: IRExpression` field; when normalize.ts's buildComposite (lines 94-99) discards a composite because inferType(draft) === UNSUPPORTED_TYPE, attach the full, already-assembled `draft` (operands and all, each individually still correctly typed where it succeeded) as attemptedStructure on the resulting UNSUPPORTED node, instead of silently dropping it.
primaryFix_buildCompositePreservation.whyThisIsTheSmallestArchitectureSupporte: 01's ledger shows the SAME defect (poison propagation discarding partial structure) recurring across 4 distinct composite kinds (ADD, SUBTRACT, IF, DURING_PERIOD) and 6 of 10 real claims - a single, generic fix at the shared buildComposite/unsupportedNode choke point remediates all of them at once, without any per-definition or per-operator special-casing. No multi-pass compile/compose/compare rewrite of compile.ts is required BY THE EVIDENCE GATHERED SO FAR - inferType's own logic is untouched (03), and every failing claim's root telemetry (01) shows the model already attempting full, correct decomposition; the loss is purely in materialization. A larger multi-pass restructuring is NOT undertaken now because no evidence in this holdout demonstrates it is needed - if the bounded fix below is implemented and the re-run holdout still fails to reach the semantic pass gate for reasons NOT explained by this fix's own scope, that would be the trigger to revisit a multi-pass architecture, not a precondition to acting now.

secondaryFix_intraDefinitionCompleteness.problem: completeness-check.ts's existing deterministic sibling-defined-term-omission detector (a regex-based '"Term" means' scan across a document's defined terms) is structurally blind to INTRA-definition component omission - it can tell you 'Consolidated EBITDA is a defined term that got a definition object' but has no visibility into 'did that definition object capture all 16 addback clauses.'
secondaryFix_intraDefinitionCompleteness.fix: Extend completeness-check.ts with an additive, generic check that walks a definition's calculationExpression tree (now, post-primary-fix, potentially carrying an UNSUPPORTED top node with a populated attemptedStructure sidecar) and reports, deterministically, how many of the attemptedStructure's own leaf/subtree operands are themselves well-typed vs. genuinely UNSUPPORTED - surfacing a machine-checkable completeness signal ('18 of 20 top-level ADD operands are well-typed IR nodes; the composite itself is UNSUPPORTED because operand #7 and #14 remain UNSUPPORTED') rather than the current all-or-nothing 'calculationExpression.kind === UNSUPPORTED' binary. This is purely additive - it does not change any existing pass/fail verdict logic, only adds a new, more granular diagnostic signal that the independent verifier and downstream review tooling can use.
secondaryFix_intraDefinitionCompleteness.noNewStatusValuesRequired: This uses the EXISTING RepresentationSufficiency enum (COMPLETE/PARTIAL/AMBIGUOUS/UNSUPPORTED/MISSING_CONTEXT/CONFLICTED, normalize.ts:28) and the existing verifier finding taxonomy - no schema migration for new status values is introduced, matching the mission's 'do not introduce schema migration unless truly unavoidable' constraint.

explicitlyOutOfScope.categoricalFilterGap: A4's Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt (per 02's residualFindingOutOfScope) - a genuine but narrow IR-expressivity gap outside the mission's own A-J test set, not fixed here.
explicitlyOutOfScope.sourceContextGaps: A3's Consolidated Maintenance EBITDA and A6's Invoice Restrictions (per 01) - genuine region/document-scoping limitations, a discovery/context-retrieval concern, not a semantic-computation-architecture concern.
explicitlyOutOfScope.schedulePromptNudge: B2's model choosing IF-nesting over the purpose-built SCHEDULE node for a pricing grid (per 02's test F note) is NOT separately fixed by adding new parser arms or enumerating grid shapes - the primaryFix above already benefits an IF-based decomposition equally (poison-propagation preservation is generic to composite kind), so no additional prompt engineering is required to reach a materially better outcome for B2; if post-fix evidence shows otherwise, a LIGHT, generic prompt clarification about SCHEDULE's applicability to tiered/pricing-grid shapes (not naming EBITDA or Superior) would be the smallest next step, not a new parser arm.

explicitlyRejectedApproaches: Raising DEFAULT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS or MAX_TEXT_RESULT_CHARS: rejected - 01's aggregateFindings shows every claim's real telemetry is far below both the token cap and the tool-call budget; this is not a truncation-driven failure.

Merely changing UNSUPPORTED to a different status label: rejected - the fix changes what STRUCTURE is preserved and visible, not what label is applied to the top-level node's overall executability, which correctly remains non-executable when genuinely poisoned.

One parser arm or special case per financial metric name (EBITDA, Net Income, etc.): rejected - the fix is a single, generic change at the shared buildComposite/unsupportedNode/completeness-check choke points, applied identically regardless of which defined term is being compiled.

A full IR rewrite / new expression kind for every gap found: rejected for the dominant defect (not needed - see 02/03); the one narrow gap that WOULD need a new kind (A4's filter case) is explicitly deferred, not implemented, per the mission's own bounded-remediation charter.

expectedImpactAcrossHoldoutClaims.A4_first_lien_debt: Consolidated Interest Expense sub-claim benefits from the primary fix (same ADD poison-propagation pattern); Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt's categorical-filter gap is out of scope and honestly not expected to change - this claim may remain the mission's tolerated 1-of-6 miss.
expectedImpactAcrossHoldoutClaims.A5_secured_net_leverage: Primary fix applicable via the DURING_PERIOD-wraps-a-poisoned-composite path.
expectedImpactAcrossHoldoutClaims.A6_new_definitions: Maintenance Liquidity benefits from the primary fix; Invoice Restrictions' gap is SOURCE_CONTEXT (Exhibit E genuinely outside instrument text) and honestly not expected to change; Monthly Factoring Report already succeeds.

expectedImpactAcrossHoldoutClaims.B2_applicable_rate: Primary fix applicable via the IF path.
expectedImpactAcrossHoldoutClaims.B3_ebitda_caps: Same region/fix as A1 - the 10%/15% cap sub-structure becomes visible as part of the same ADD tree once preserved.
expectedImpactAcrossHoldoutClaims.B4_cash_sweep_cure: Already compiles with real rules today; not affected by (and not put at risk by) this fix - explicitly re-verified as a regression check post-implementation.

conclusion: Proceed to a bounded, additive implementation: (1) IRUnsupportedExpression.attemptedStructure (new optional field, ir/types.ts), (2) buildComposite/unsupportedNode change to populate it (semantic/normalize.ts), (3) intra-definition completeness-check extension to read it (semantic/completeness-check.ts). type-check.ts's inferType is NOT modified. No new IR expression kinds are added. No package- or metric-specific code is added. This directly implements the mission's own required distinction between semantic-capture-completeness and deterministic-executability without introducing new status values.
